verdict.rationale: Brex's Team API documentation mentions managing 'cards' alongside users/departments, and the Budgets API supports 'auto-enforced controls' on spend limits, suggesting card/spend scoping is possible, but no evidence explicitly describes instant virtual card issuance scoped to a specific vendor or ad-spend purpose. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of virtual card creation flow, vendor-lock/purpose-lock controls, and any hands-on or community confirmation of this specific capability.
